snapshots.notes: Frozen local snapshot of the IANA Language Subtag Registry and license evidence. The public endpoints are mutable, so checksum-pinned regeneration uses these retained inputs.
Pinned local snapshot of selected Unicode 17.0.0 UCD files, including auxiliary segmentation and general category property files.
Pinned local snapshot of selected cldr-core supplemental JSON files.

Pinned metadata, checksums, sizes, timestamps, row counts, and local raw Tatoeba 2026-06-06 French sentence and French-linked parallel artifacts. The selected sentence export is retained as a frozen snapshot because the upstream per-language URL is mutable; large parallel artifacts remain optional acquisition inputs.
Pinned Lexique 3.83 archive, extracted TSV, README, and release notes. The generated package must remain share-alike isolated.
Pinned UniMorph French README license evidence and inflection table from commit f672f8cceb2d5f5a1e2241b5622c8845f8274635.

Co-located but independent evidence: pinned checksum sidecars for the Wikidata 2026-06-08 full JSON entity dump, plus deterministic gzip-compressed Arabic, English, and French core extracts retrieved independently from Wikidata Query Service on 2026-06-12. The query-service extracts are not claimed to derive from the full dump; the full raw dump remains artifact-backed.

Tatoeba weekly French exports 2026-06-06
sourcePolicies.notes: Exact Tatoeba weekly French sentence and French-linked parallel exports. Attribution is preserved through detailed sentence artifacts and package reports. This is a second-wave French source, not a first-wave lexicon, morphology, syntax, search, or KB source. It can provide task support only when transformed into local sentence rows, alignment/link rows, or an equivalent local index; the active French corpus and parallel packs materialize those local rows.

sourcePolicies.name: Lexique 3.83
sourcePolicies.notes: Pinned audit found the official Lexique 3.83 README and current Lexique page declare Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike. The official Lexique383.zip artifact SHA-256 observed during audit was e181d132b3b0d3d87efc98d376968441b517353933011cebea5366321a6024e6, but this source must remain outside default French composites.
